comment: I have reviewed the proposed Nonprofit Service Advisory Committee resolution and I’m in full support of the proposed resolution as written. Unfortunately, I will not be able to attend the meeting tonight but please add my input and email to the record for public comment on this item. If you would like to discuss further or have any questions for me, please reach out via email or my cell phone. I am available this afternoon if needed. Thank you for your time and attention to the makeup and functioning of this committee and I look forward to the new process.
source: eComment (written; published verbatim in council meeting minutes)
